source: Xurshid's 30 Reel Scripts (2 Nov 2026) — follow scene-by-scene
voice: Xurshid generates VO in Google AI Studio (Finn) and lays it under the animation. The builder BURNS THE VO LINE IN as a bottom caption so the reel reads muted, and leaves audio headroom (music bed + SFX only, no speech).
close: Every reel ends on the wordmark + 'Link in bio' (common.endcard_bio).
no_camera_note: The guide's preamble says nothing needs a camera. Days 22-29 are phrased as if filmed ('you hold', 'straight to camera'). Build those as animated/typographic equivalents: handwriting, held-card graphics, illustrated desk scenes. Never fake a photoreal person.

beats.anim: the word ADAPTIVE assembles from glitching fragments
beats.vo: The SAT changes halfway through.

beats.anim: a single path splits into two routes, one easy one hard, labels sliding in
the hard route lights up, a score range climbing beside it
beats.vo: Harder second module means a higher ceiling.

beats.anim: routes collapse into the app wordmark
beats.vo: SAT Studio builds that second module the same way.

beats.anim: wordmark holds
phone chat bubbles, timestamp 11:04
reply bubbles land one by one, each whipping in
beats.text: same  ·  what do i even study

beats.anim: the chat dissolves; three lines type themselves out
beats.text: 1. One topic   2. 20 questions   3. Write every mistake

beats.anim: the three lines compress into a single card
beats.vo: That's the whole system. There isn't more.

beats.anim: loop back to the 11:04 bubble
handwriting: a wrong answer appears, then gets crossed out
beats.vo: One notebook. Only mistakes.

beats.anim: beneath it, the reason writes itself in
speed ramp: pages flip past, filling up
beats.vo: Same mistake twice means you never understood it.

beats.anim: one page holds; a repeated pattern circles itself in red
page closes

days.title: The desk, built piece by piece

beats.anim: an empty isometric desk
each object drops in and labels itself: timer, water, pencil, blank paper
a phone slides off the desk into a drawer, which shuts
the timer starts counting on the desk
beats.vo: Test day feels normal if practice looks like test day.

beats.anim: scene holds

days.title: The gap between practice and test day

beats.anim: two bars, 1400 and 1280, the gap flashing red
beats.vo: You practice at 1400 and score 1280.

beats.anim: cause 1 animates: a clock icon pulsing over every question
cause 2: an untimed practice page, no clock anywhere
the two bars slide together and merge
beats.vo: One full timed test a week. Even a bad one.

beats.anim: merged bar holds

days.title: The morning, drawn on a clock

beats.anim: a clock face, hand sweeping to 7:00
icons arc around the dial in sequence: water, breakfast, five warm-up questions
beats.vo: I don't study. I warm up.

beats.anim: a phone icon greys out and drops off the dial
beats.text: No phone until the test ends

beats.anim: the hand reaches start time, the dial turns into a timer
beats.vo: Same routine every time.

beats.anim: timer holds

days.title: Three words that move the answer

beats.anim: 'at least' slams onto screen, letter by letter
a > symbol morphs into ≥ beside it
'no more than' and 'exactly' drop in, each with its symbol
all three stack, then the wrong symbols shatter away
beats.vo: Most wrong answers are reading mistakes.

beats.anim: three correct symbols hold

days.title: Six weeks, drawn as a line

beats.anim: an empty chart, axis labels fading in
beats.vo: Six practice tests. Including the bad one.

beats.anim: the line draws itself week by week, each point landing with a light flash
the line dips at week four; the dip circles itself
the cause types in beneath
beats.vo: I'd stopped doing the easy questions.

beats.anim: the full line holds
a countdown ring snaps to 25:00
the ring drains while tally marks stack up on the beat
ring hits zero; the tally resolves into a count
the 4 wrong peel off into a separate pile
beats.vo: The four wrong ones are tomorrow's session. SAT Studio sorts them.

beats.anim: pile holds

days.title: How do you even study for this?

beats.anim: one chat bubble arrives
beats.text: how do you even study for this

beats.anim: three reply bubbles land, each match-cutting into an icon: test, notebook, repeat arrow
the three icons loop in a cycle
beats.vo: There's no trick. It's just reps.

beats.anim: a final bubble arrives
the cycle keeps turning
handwriting: a problem appears line by line, no voice
each step writes itself, macro zoom following the pen
the answer circles itself
the whole worked page pulls back into view
beats.vo: Writing it out is slower. You get more right.

beats.anim: page holds
a calculator icon and a pencil icon face off
beats.vo: Half of you are using this wrong.

beats.anim: task cards fly into the calculator column
more cards fly to the pencil column
the pencil column pulses once
beats.vo: Set the problem up by hand first. Always.

beats.anim: both columns hold
a chaotic page, work scattered everywhere
the scattered pieces slide into four labeled rows
three more pages wipe past in the same format
beats.vo: Same notebook. Now I can actually review it.

beats.anim: the four-row template holds alone
hold
a 44:00 bar fills the screen
the bar slices into 22 equal blocks, each stamped 1:35
one block stretches past 2:00 and turns red
the red block lifts out of the row
beats.vo: My app flags the ones that took too long.

beats.anim: row holds
a card flips up, stamped
card 1 whips in: a play button looping with no pencil beside it
card 2: easy questions greyed out, hard ones highlighted
card 3: a blank notebook, nothing recorded
three cards fan out together
a blank index card slides in
beats.vo: These come from my mistakes, not a textbook.

beats.anim: handwriting fills the front, then the card flips and the back writes itself
beats.text: Front: the trap. Back: the fix.

beats.anim: the card morphs into a stack of forty, flipping through
beats.vo: Forty cards. All mine.

beats.anim: two cards lift out and flip
stack holds
a bubble sheet with empty rows
beats.vo: There's no penalty for guessing.

beats.anim: blanks fill in one by one, a counter rising
one choice greys out and the counter jumps
a second greys out, counter jumps again
beats.vo: Cross out one, and a guess is worth a lot more.

beats.anim: counter holds at 50%
a 24-hour bar across the screen
school, travel and sleep block out in grey, one after another
beats.vo: Nobody gets three free hours.

beats.anim: one 40-minute slot stays lit
the slot repeats across seven days
beats.vo: Every day. Small amounts.

beats.anim: week holds
a dense word problem fills the frame
beats.vo: Stop reading these top to bottom.

beats.anim: the final question line lifts out and docks at the top
only the numbers it needs light up; the rest dims
beats.vo: You stop holding information you don't need.

beats.anim: the solved line writes itself in
beats.vo: Most of the word problems in my app are built this way.

beats.anim: hold
an empty four-week calendar grid
each week fills and labels itself in turn
beats.text: W1 basics · W2 drills · W3 timed · W4 full tests

beats.anim: week 4 tries to jump to the front and snaps back
beats.vo: You can't time something you can't do yet.

beats.anim: the finished grid settles
grid holds
a 60-second ring starts draining
a breathing circle expands and contracts inside the ring
beats.vo: Water. Shoulders down. Don't look back.

beats.anim: 'Module 1' fades out of frame entirely
beats.text: Module 1 is finished. Leave it there.

beats.anim: ring hits zero, a fresh page slides in
beats.vo: Sixty seconds. That's all it takes.

beats.anim: page holds

days.title: Six weeks of scores, said out loud

beats.anim: a handwritten score sheet rises into frame (held-card graphic, no person)
beats.vo: Six tests. Here's every score, including the bad one.

beats.anim: scores write themselves in order, including the week it dropped
the dip circles itself and the cause writes in
beats.vo: It dropped when I stopped doing the easy questions.

beats.anim: app named once over the finished sheet
beats.vo: All of it tracked in SAT Studio.

beats.anim: hold
wide illustrated desk scene, music starts
beat-matched push-ins across the desk: lamp, notebook, headphones, a plant
the lamp clicks on and warms the scene
beats.vo: This is where everything happens.

beats.anim: a last slow pan across the desk
hold

days.title: Five things that waste your study time

beats.anim: five tally strokes slam on at once
beats.vo: Number one is the one everyone does.

beats.anim: 5: rewriting neat notes
4 and 3: watching lessons on 2x, studying with your phone out
2 and 1: no timer, and never reviewing mistakes
hold

days.title: Start here if you're at zero

beats.anim: cold open, text slams straight in, no setup
beats.vo: If you've never opened an SAT question, start here.

beats.anim: step 1 card: take one untimed practice test to find your level
step 2 card: pick your two weakest topics only
step 3, with the app named
beats.vo: Then practise those two until they're boring. My app sorts them for you.

beats.anim: hold
an open bag illustrated on a bed
each item drops in and labels itself: ID, pencils, calculator, water, snack
a closed book greys out and slides away
beats.vo: No studying tonight. It won't help.

beats.anim: lights out, bag by the door
hold
honest typed opening line on a plain field
beats.vo: I built an SAT app because I couldn't find one I liked.

beats.anim: the problem: question banks that didn't match the real test, shown as two mismatched cards
beats.vo: The questions were close. Not the same.

beats.anim: what was made instead, described in words, nothing shown
the name lands once
beats.vo: It's called SAT Studio.

beats.anim: hold

days.title: Answering the question I get most

beats.anim: a comment card on screen
the answer types in with the caveat
beats.vo: One hour, every day. Not five hours on Sunday.

beats.anim: seven small blocks spread across a week vs one tall Sunday block
beats.text: 7 hours spread out beats 7 hours at once

beats.anim: the week version holds alone
beats.vo: That's the whole answer.

beats.anim: hold
a follower's question card arrives
beats.text: the question, as they wrote it

beats.anim: the answer works itself out on paper, handwriting animation
beats.vo: your answer

beats.anim: the part most people get wrong highlights itself
an empty comment box invites the next one
beats.vo: Ask me the next one in the comments.

beats.anim: hold
a fast montage of the month's title cards
beats.vo: Thirty days. Here's what actually helped.

beats.anim: lesson 1 and 2, said plainly
beats.text: 1. Easy questions are points · 2. Write every mistake

beats.anim: lesson 3
the app is named and the next step given
beats.vo: Everything I used is in SAT Studio.

beats.anim: loop to the Day 1 ADAPTIVE frame
